plan.title: Fail closed on all-invisible-unicode triage queue titles

narratives.Description: sanitizeQueueTitle must return QUARANTINED_TITLE_PLACEHOLDER when invisible-unicode stripping yields empty content, not raw unstripped bytes.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Change cache.ts sanitizeQueueTitle branch; add regression test in cache-branches.test.ts.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator running triage:queue, I want all-invisible-unicode issue titles quarantined so attacker-controlled bytes never reach agent context.

narrative.Acceptance: Returns QUARANTINED_TITLE_PLACEHOLDER when stripped length is 0.
